why: McNally West is the village's expansion of 3494 James N. McNally Campground, not a separate place. The board named it 'James N. McNally Campground West' (Burnett County Sentinel, via search snippet), and the Nov 2024 coverage of the approved expansion describes 30 added sites, 7-8 RV-ready, a $20k shower building and asphalt looping (moderncampground.com 2024-11-29). Esri imagery (read 2026-11-17) shows the new loop under construction at about 45.7782,-92.6945, with its own paved entrance off W Olson Dr. Its sites are only about 225 m west of 3494's west loop and 460 m from 3494's pin, well under the 1 km split threshold. Google Maps (read 2026-11-17) has no separate place: searches for 'McNally West' return 3494's listing, titled 'James McNally Main Campground', 4.4/22, 715-463-2405.
name: James N. McNally Campground West (McNally West)
flags: For 3494's note: the West section is a separate loop about 225 m west of the original sites, with its own paved entrance off W Olson Dr (400 W Olson Dr geocodes to 45.7781,-92.6925). Planned as 30 sites from full hookup to primitive, 7-8 of them RV-ready, plus a shower building. The Sentinel says its sites are short-term only (under 2 weeks) and that all tent camping moves there from the original campground. 3494's note already mentions it and gives the September 2025 opening.

Naming conflict: Woodall's Campground Magazine (2025-08-25, quoting the Sentinel of 2025-08-22) calls the nearly finished new campground the 'East Addition of the James McNally Campground', while an earlier Sentinel piece reports the board naming the western addition 'James N. McNally Campground West'. Imagery shows only one new loop, on the west side.
3494's sites.count (38) covers the original loop only. If the west section is counted, the campground has about 68 sites.
burnettcountysentinel.com returned HTTP 429 to WebFetch on 2026-11-17. Add it to the refusal list.
